qualifications: Instrumented full SchematicEditor in isolated GitHub CI; candidate, not a production deployment.
S4 is the attributed 17-component/14-wire audit reconstruction, not an export of the original user project.
Commit latency means native input to a matching committed document/DOM; it is not a measurement of physical paint.
Move latency starts at pointer release, not at the beginning of the complete drag gesture.
The nominal profile is native Undo/Redo between 220 and 330 ohms after both inputs were warmed; it is not first uncached nominal-entry latency.
For the code-closed source profile, opening the panel occurs before the measured native input and is excluded from that latency.
Numeric passes and visual replay are separate. RAF fields are scheduling evidence, not proof of paint.
All 2880 measured rows and every deadline overrun are retained. No latency percentiles are pooled across unlike profiles.
Paired initialDiagnostic equality is distinct from the separate full direct/Worker parity test fixtures.
Package validation does not decide numerical performance benefit, independent final review, General/R4 CI qualification, cold load, or the full R10–R12 budget.

finalConvergence.reason: Accepted foreign PR1098 changes four actual compiled editor inputs; A measurements cannot be relabelled as the converged build. Repeat the same paired protocol with c76 before the final candidate.
